snippet.title: In-game footage from Honkai: Nexus Anima
snippet.description:
Recruitment for the Honkai: Nexus Anima "Nexus Bond Test" is now live. Go to the official website and fill out the questionnaire or follow the official Honkai: Nexus Anima accounts and community updates for more chances to join the test!

*The game is under development, and subject to change.
*This Nexus Bond Test is available in 5 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean. Support for more languages will be added in the future.

Pre-register for Honkai: Nexus Anima:
https://hoyo.link/rHM5MbpKT

▼ Follow us for the latest updates and announcements:
· X: https://hoyo.link/XtmOWJm8l
· Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/honkaina
· TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@honkaina_en
· Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HonkaiNA/
· Discord: https://discord.gg/honkainexusanima
